# Reverend Jo

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c27 P28](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** minister  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Reverend  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>; Mr. Blake  <sub>[v3 c27 P28](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P22](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0022)</sub>; Jonas  <sub>[v3 c27 P22](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0022)</sub>

## Appearance

He is described as an ugly man.

_Sources: [v3 c27 P22](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0022)_

## Personality

He is quick to make up his mind and offers practical rules to help others navigate perplexity.

_Sources: [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)_

## Traits

- decisive  <sub>[v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)</sub>

## Goals

- take a mission church down on Patterson Street in the slums  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended and graduated from St. Columbia. During his student years, he met Philippa Gordon, who eventually realized she was deeply in love with him despite his lack of wealth and early intentions to marry a rich suitor. He gave Philippa a rule to resolve her indecisiveness by considering what she would wish she had done by age eighty. Following his graduation, he arranged to take charge of a small mission church on Patterson Street in the slums and married Philippa.

_Sources: [v3 c27 P22](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0022), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c27 P28](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0028), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)_
